**T4C — Compliant (preferred level).**

- **Customer convenience right:** § 9.4 lets us terminate the Agreement *or any Order Form* without cause; § 29.4 sets that notice at thirty days.
- **No exit cost:** we owe "only accrued Fees," and Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period (reinforced by § 10.2). No early-termination fee, penalty or liquidated-damages mechanic appears anywhere in the document.
- **No Vendor convenience right:** Vendor may terminate only for our uncured material breach (§ 9.1), insolvency (§ 9.2), or the infringing item under the IP indemnity (which expressly bars terminating unaffected Services). Customer-only non-renewal notice in § 8.2 is a RENEWAL term, not a mid-term Vendor convenience right, so it is not flagged here.

No redline proposed.
